description: Dark Naturalism is an aesthetic derived from Dark Academia and Naturecore that emphasizes the study of the natural world through a lens of mystery and folklore. While it shares the intellectual focus of academic aesthetics, it rejects the urban and cloistered setting of the university in favor of the "field trip" and the deep woods. The aesthetic focuses on the duality of being a diligent student, balancing midterm revisions and tea consumption, while simultaneously investigating mysterious forces, local trails, and ghost anthropology.
